messages:
Sara: Passing MarlinWave to CS — signed yesterday. Quick context: SSO via SAML, private VPC, expected steady usage ~10k tokens/day first month, renewal in ~11 months. Sales notes + contact info in the CRM link.

Jamal: Thanks Sara. Assigning owners and flagging renewal watch. Two quick Qs: any compliance boxes (BAA, SOC2) already requested? Also do they expect dedicated capacity or hosted?

Sara: They asked about HIPAA-adjacent handling (BAA required). Sales asked about dedicated for initial rollout because latency is a hard ask. Contacts: mike@marlinwave.com (IT lead), rachel@marlinwave.com (product). Payment = Net30.

Lee: Onboarding here — I'll own provisioning. Need SAML metadata + preferred VPC CIDR and list of integration endpoints. Can someone paste SAML EntityID and the IP ranges? I'll open infra ticket once I have them.

Sara: Pasting the minimal SAML snippet we captured (full metadata in CRM):
```
<EntityDescriptor entityID="https://idp.marlinwave.com/saml">...
```
VPC CIDR they requested: 10.240.0.0/16 (they may refine).

Ana: Support chiming in — post-provisioning I'll handle runbook and escalation path. Heads-up: if Dedicated, lead time ~2 weeks for capacity + cert provisioning. Please include primary contact and preferred maintenance windows.

Jamal: Owners and next steps (I'll track):
- Jamal (CSM): overall owner, weekly cadence + renewal risk monitor.
- Lee (Onboard PM): infra provisioning + SSO enablement.
- Ana (Support): post-provisioning runbook + on-call handoff.
- Eng (infra): VPC peering, IP allowlist, KMS/HSM setup (TBD assignee).

Action items:
1) Sara to drop full SAML metadata and Mike/Rachel contact card into the tracker (Sara) — due EOD today.
2) Lee to create infra ticket referencing: `marlinwave-1632-vpc` and request Dedicated pool estimate — due tomorrow.
3) Ana to draft initial runbook template (contacts, SLAs, failover) and share in this thread — due +3 days.
4) Jamal to start renewal watch and add discount risk flag in CRM (they asked about price review at 10mo) — due this week.

Sara: FYI finance needs copy of the signed SOW for Net30; cc @matt_finance.

ops-bot: Ticket created: #INFRA-4821 linked to marlinwave-1632-vpc (assignee: unassigned).

Lee: Quick note on allowlist example for infra team:
```
- MarlinWave CIDR: 10.240.0.0/16
- Our egress IPs: 34.82.145.10, 34.82.145.11
```
Add to ticket.

Ana: Also capture expected traffic pattern: spike during onboarding (10k tokens/day -> peaks at ~50k/day for 48-72h). I'll include that in runbook.

Jamal: Good catch. I'll schedule a kickoff call with MarlinWave for Monday 10am PT — invite will include Sara, Mike, Rachel, Lee, Ana, and eng lead.

Sara: Thanks all — tagging any missing folks: @eng-oncall please monitor ticket INFRA-4821 and propose assignee.

Lee: I'll post a short checklist in 1 hour and link the tracker.

Ana: I'll start the runbook outline now and post a first draft by EOD tomorrow.

Jamal: Closing for now — will update thread after kickoff. :thumbsup:
